title: AP inspection activity and data quality

summary.sql: SELECT count(*) AS records, count(DISTINCT order_number) AS orders, count(DISTINCT product_mlfb) AS products, count(DISTINCT test_station_identifier) AS stations, count(*) FILTER (WHERE G0003 IS NOT NULL) AS code_present, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE G0003 IS NOT NULL) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS code_present_pct, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_last_measurement = false) AS non_last, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_last_measurement = false) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS non_last_pct FROM ap WHERE ($date_from IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) >= $date_from) AND ($date_to IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) < $date_to) AND ($source IS NULL OR source = $source) AND ($station IS NULL OR test_station_identifier = $station) AND ($product IS NULL OR product_mlfb = $product) AND ($order IS NULL OR order_number = $order)

daily.sql: SELECT CAST(CAST(date_trunc('day', inspection_date) AS DATE) AS VARCHAR) AS day, source, count(*) AS records FROM ap WHERE ($date_from IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) >= $date_from) AND ($date_to IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) < $date_to) AND ($source IS NULL OR source = $source) AND ($station IS NULL OR test_station_identifier = $station) AND ($product IS NULL OR product_mlfb = $product) AND ($order IS NULL OR order_number = $order) GROUP BY day, source ORDER BY day, source

by_station.sql: SELECT test_station_identifier AS station, count(*) AS records FROM ap WHERE ($date_from IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) >= $date_from) AND ($date_to IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) < $date_to) AND ($source IS NULL OR source = $source) AND ($station IS NULL OR test_station_identifier = $station) AND ($product IS NULL OR product_mlfb = $product) AND ($order IS NULL OR order_number = $order) GROUP BY station ORDER BY records DESC, station

top_products.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT product_mlfb, count(*) AS records FROM ap WHERE ($date_from IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) >= $date_from) AND ($date_to IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) < $date_to) AND ($source IS NULL OR source = $source) AND ($station IS NULL OR test_station_identifier = $station) AND ($product IS NULL OR product_mlfb = $product) AND ($order IS NULL OR order_number = $order) GROUP BY product_mlfb), ranked AS (SELECT product_mlfb, records, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY records DESC, product_mlfb NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM grouped), bucketed AS (SELECT CASE WHEN rn <= 10 THEN COALESCE(product_mlfb, '(missing product)') ELSE 'Other products' END AS product, records FROM ranked) SELECT product, CAST(sum(records) AS BIGINT) AS records FROM bucketed GROUP BY product ORDER BY records DESC, product

g0003_codes.sql: SELECT G0003 AS code, count(*) AS records FROM ap WHERE G0003 IS NOT NULL AND ($date_from IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) >= $date_from) AND ($date_to IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) < $date_to) AND ($source IS NULL OR source = $source) AND ($station IS NULL OR test_station_identifier = $station) AND ($product IS NULL OR product_mlfb = $product) AND ($order IS NULL OR order_number = $order) GROUP BY code ORDER BY records DESC, code

station_day.sql: SELECT CAST(CAST(date_trunc('day', inspection_date) AS DATE) AS VARCHAR) AS day, test_station_identifier AS station, count(*) AS records FROM ap WHERE ($date_from IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) >= $date_from) AND ($date_to IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) < $date_to) AND ($source IS NULL OR source = $source) AND ($station IS NULL OR test_station_identifier = $station) AND ($product IS NULL OR product_mlfb = $product) AND ($order IS NULL OR order_number = $order) GROUP BY day, station ORDER BY day, station

recent_records.sql: SELECT CAST(inspection_date AS VARCHAR) AS inspection_date, order_number, product_mlfb, test_station_identifier, source, sequence_number, G0003, is_last_measurement FROM ap WHERE ($date_from IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) >= $date_from) AND ($date_to IS NULL OR CAST(inspection_date AS DATE) < $date_to) AND ($source IS NULL OR source = $source) AND ($station IS NULL OR test_station_identifier = $station) AND ($product IS NULL OR product_mlfb = $product) AND ($order IS NULL OR order_number = $order) ORDER BY inspection_date DESC, order_number, sequence_number NULLS LAST
